Applied observation includes projected RPC/long-poll/Python/socket overhead. Every complete frame hash matches across variants/trials; independent edited text, full retained rows, last text and empty UI errors checked outside timing. Two excluded warmup trials, seeded shuffled pairs, warm filesystem, serial measurement without builds/stress. Not event-to-photon, cold start, RSS or Linux timing.
